pages.text: An endless supply of water for reactors and the Coolant Mixer. Place it touching $(l)at least 2 water source blocks$() (the same rule as an infinite water source) and give it power.

$(li)Pumps $(l)500 mB/t$() with $(l)40 FE/t$() and pushes it into adjacent $(l:cables/liquid_pipe)Liquid Pipes$(/l) and machines (water is a liquid: a $(l:cables/gas_pipe)Gas Pipe$(/l) will not take it).$(br)$(li)One pump feeds 500 heat per tick: enough for a Small tower and a Medium one up to 250%. A Large tower at full power (2,000 heat) needs 4 pumps.
$(li)It has no GUI: $(l)right-click$() it to see what it is doing.
